Based on the early screening conducted in the SA, less than 100 persons from all potential

project sites combined are likely to be affected by the DVRP, hence no specific Resettlement] Action Plan (RAP) would be necessary (World Bank Resettlement Policy indicates that where

land acquisition and other adverse social impacts would affect more than 200 persons, a RAP

will have to be prepared i.e., separate and apart from the Resettlement Policy Framework, and to

accompany it, though an abbreviated resettlement plan is to be prepared as indicated earlier in

cases of less than 200 PAPs). This abbreviated resettlement plan is a condition of financing for

sub-project activities. It will include details such as a 'census survey of displaced persons and

valuation of assets' (for further details see paragraph 22 of OP 4.12 i.e., Annex A of

OB/BP/4.12).
